newsitem.title: FRANCE: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF MEN'S SLALOM WINNER.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF MEN'S SLALOM WINNER.

text.p: Profile of the winner of Sunday's men's World Cup slalom:
World Cup victories: Six (all slaloms) - Kitzbuehel 1996, Lillehammer 1996, Park City 1996, Madonna di Campiglio 1996, Kranjska Gora 1997, Chamonix 1997.

Other facts: Had to wait until last year to win his first World Cup in Kitzbuehel but he has been unstoppable so far this season by winning four races out of five and finishing second in the other. He decided to become a top sportsman to please his aunts, one of whom won a silver medal in hepthatlon in the 1968 Mexico Olympics while the other was a successful 400 metres runner.
